title: Always Up to Date
notes: Automatic updates: the demo checks for a new version when it starts. If there is one, the main menu shows "Update available" with what's new (hover it). Click Update now: it downloads just the game data (a few MB), restarts, and you're on the new version.
The game folder now has Anthreyel.exe plus Anthreyel.pck (the game itself). Keep them together.
Game Guide: a new About page with the version and credits.
